name: Thorn Tomahead
description: The user stands at the horse's shoulder line where the rider's blade cannot swing cleanly.

name: Manacling Edgecurve
description: The beard hooks a rider's boot and heaves upward, tilting the seat.

name: Rumble Birchhelve
description: A quick chop cuts the reins at the bit ring and leaves the rider without control.

name: Torrent Chuck
description: A sidestep at the last stride takes the user off the path of a charging horse.

name: Lobassault
description: The bit slashes the saddle girth in passing so the rider slides from the saddle.

name: Drubbing Lightbit
description: An overhand throw at the rider's chest forces a raised guard and slows the horse.

name: Lob Greave
description: The beard snares a stirrup strap and the user's weight drags the rider's foot loose.

name: Gyve Fling
description: With the beard hooked under the rider's arm, the user swings on the haft and pulls the rider from the saddle.

name: Slagflint
description: A fan of thrown axes sweeps across the front rank of a charge and breaks its line.

name: Intent Quickbit
description: Qi in the arm lightens the draw so the axe leaves the belt without a hitch of the shoulder.

name: Facethead
description: A held breath steadies the axe's balance in the hand so heavy blows pass into the stance.

name: Waning Spikepoll
description: The user traces the axe's likely path through the air with a thin qi sense before release.

name: Ravaging Hurl
description: A flat, hard throw drives the axe without arc at a target in plain sight.

name: Might Toss
description: A push off the rear foot sends the user into a fast three-step advance behind the thrown axe.

name: Novahurl
description: A thread of qi trails the axe and nudges its spin mid-flight, bending its line around a raised shield.

name: Murk Thumbnotch
description: A tuned tap of the haft knocks an arrow or thrown blade off its path.

name: Lancing Throwhelve
description: Qi lingering in a landed axe drives the bit deeper when the user snaps a hand closed.

name: Splitting Glint Lob
description: Three axes in a rolling volley are each trailed by qi and curve to a different part of the target.

name: Toss Barrage
description: An axe that missed is steered by trailing qi to turn and strike again from the side.

name: Chime Balancepoint
description: A look at plate seams, straps and joints tells the user where the bit can find a gap.

name: Unmaking Thumbnotch
description: Chops along the rivets of a breastplate loosen the plates and dent them inward.

name: Rumblepitch
description: A poll knock to the visor snaps the helm back and blurs the wearer's sight.

name: Gust Fling
description: The user circles a slow armored opponent, striking and leaving before the counter arrives.

name: Novachuck
description: The poll spike is driven into the gap behind the elbow plate with the user's full weight behind it.

name: Chime Lightbit
description: The beard catches the lip of a breastplate and peels it outward to expose the padding.

name: Harpooning Tailknob
description: Rapid poll blows on one plate set it ringing and rattle the wearer's ribs through the armor.

name: Wrecking Birchhelve
description: A thrown axe's spike finds the open throat gap of a gorget when the wearer lifts their chin.

name: Balancepoint Fastness
description: A brace of axes on belt and shoulder strap lets the user stand ready without clutter.

name: Pitchthrash
description: A hand sweeps an axe from the bundle and releases it in one flowing motion.

name: Edgecurve Remedy
description: The user keeps a trained count of axes left and the distance to each target.

name: Hoarfrost Tomahead
description: Left and right hands alternate the throws, each axe leaving as the other lands.

name: Gustchuck
description: A crouched shuffle behind cover refills the hands from the bundle between volleys.

name: Unbroken Quickbit
description: A parry with a held axe keeps the user safe while the other hand draws.

name: Glint Chuck
description: Three axes thrown on rising arcs fall onto one target in turn from different heights.

name: Granite Throwhelve
description: Axes thrown in quick sequence at separate foes keep a skirmish line from advancing.

name: Flintcloak
description: A held axe covers the body while the other hand throws from behind the guard.

name: Mayhem Spikepoll
description: Axes thrown in rapid succession fall across open ground and keep a group from regrouping.

name: Tailknob Assault
description: Throws, steps and second throws chain so each axe lands as the pursuing user closes the distance.

name: Rupturing Tomahead
description: Both hatchets leave the belt together in the court's draw, one for the guard and one for the cut.

name: Ironhead
description: Axes held high and low form the court's paired guard, covering head and ribs.

name: Granite Balancepoint
description: A pivot on the lead foot swings the bit around in the court's first chop.

name: Ravaging Lob
description: Two short tosses at the shins, one from each hand, break the opponent's advance.

name: Careening Hurl
description: The user slides aside as water finds the basin's low side, leaving the blow in empty air.

name: Rumble Thumbnotch
description: Both beards hook the opponent's wrists and part them wide, opening the chest.

name: Furrowing Tailknob
description: Hatchets thrown from both hands cross in flight and land a hand's breadth apart in the torso.

name: Murk Edgecurve
description: The axes fold across each other like river currents and turn two simultaneous blows aside.

name: Hour Spikepoll
description: A cut with one hatchet and a throw from the other share a line, so the dodge from the first meets the second.

name: Paralyzing Throwhelve
description: Both beards close on an opponent's arm from either side and lock it fast for a following chop.

name: Quickbit Hauberk
description: Weight rests high on the toes with the axe cocked back like a perched hawk's wing.

name: Toxinchuck
description: The beard snatches at a raised weapon wrist like a claw and pulls it down.

name: Blaze Chuck
description: From a high step the user drops the bit down and forward in a falling cut.

name: Blaze Lightbit
description: A throw along a straight low line skims the earth beneath the opponent's guard.

name: Fling Spurt
description: A backstep with both arms flared wide draws the opponent forward into a prepared line.

name: Headcloak
description: The axe flicks like a pinion feather and turns a thrust onto the haft.

name: Gust Pitch
description: From a leap the axe is thrown downward at a steep angle onto a defender behind cover.

name: Skinning Toss
description: The beard and the spike strike in one swing, one at the guard and one at the ribs.

name: Hurlleap
description: A rising step up a slope or stair lifts the user above the opponent's guard for a chop.

name: Birchremedy
description: The user fixes on the target's centre as a hawk marks prey and reads the range for a precise throw.

name: Intent Hurl
description: A leap, a throw and a landing cut link as one dive, the thrown axe landing as the user does.

name: Slagfling
description: Axes thrown from a high place rain onto the ground below and keep a group from massing.

name: Birchhelve Canter
description: The user's steps curve around an opponent like a river bend and end at the flank.

name: Edgecurve Assault
description: Two chops, left then right, flow one into the next like twin streams.

name: Ironflint
description: Low crossed axes hold the line like stepping stones across a ford and stop a thrust at the thigh.

name: Scything Birchhelve
description: The first axe is thrown and the second drawn in the same sweep of the arm.

name: Flinthauberk
description: A blow caught between the hafts is led around in a circle that drains its force.

name: Sanguine Pitch
description: Both bits descend in one stroke onto a single target from two angles.

name: Hoarfrost Lob
description: Axes are thrown in a rushing chain of three, each released as the last one lands.

name: Doctrine Fling
description: Two axes strike the same point at once from opposite sides, converging like rivers meeting.

name: Throwhelve Maelstrom
description: Hatchets fan out over a ford or shoreline in a widening spread and hold a crossing group.

name: Staunch Balancepoint
description: The user stands with feet apart and the hatchet low, reading the wind's pull on the body.

name: Wrecking Thumbnotch
description: A chop angled against the crosswind lets the gust add its push to the blow.

name: Glinttoss
description: A throw taken on a held bearing lands where the user's eye was fixed.

name: Gusthead
description: The user steps along a ridge edge where a pursuer cannot follow without risk.

name: Implacable Tomahead
description: The axe swings with a gust-like turn of the body and sends a thrust wide.

name: Blazebirch
description: A throw released with a tailwind rides the air far past the usual range.

name: Suppressing Quickbit
description: The beard hooks a shield and the user turns into the wind, using the push to tear it down.

name: Aegisflint
description: A sworn stance held without wavering shuts out repeated cuts from the user's line.

name: Skinning Spikepoll
description: Axes thrown in the gust's flow spread across an open slope and stall a loose formation.

name: Hour Toss
description: A held bearing, a throw and a close chop follow one another so each lands on the line the last opened.

name: Adamant Lightbit
description: Feet planted on bare ground, the user holds a stance sworn not to give an inch.

name: Throwhelve Assault
description: One deliberate chop is made once, with no second try, so all the weight goes into it.

name: Drubbing Pitch
description: A throw skims along the plateau's rim and lands behind a defender who trusts the drop to cover his flank.

name: Perceptive Tailknob
description: The user reads grass and cloth for the wind's bend before releasing.

name: Gust Hurl
description: A long stride across open ground changes the bearing to the opponent.

name: Murk Lightbit
description: The haft turns with the body's push and sends a cut past the shoulder.

name: Flingbarrage
description: A heavy throw sends the axe through a hide shield or thin boards.

name: Glint Balancepoint
description: A second axe follows the first along the same sworn line and lands exactly where it fell.

name: Bounding Chuck
description: The user charges downwind, speed carrying body and axe through a gap in the line.

name: Harpooning Fling
description: The user swears to hold a bearing and throws axes in a sweeping barrage across it, holding all who cross.

name: Intent Pitch
description: A throw, a gust-driven step and a chop make one unbroken run across open ground.

name: Staunch Quickbit
description: The feet are set facing the target's line of approach and held there.

name: Sanguine Edgecurve
description: A cut taken along the line of travel meets the opponent's advance head-on.

name: Birchtorment
description: The hatchet is drawn and thrown in one sweep of the arm, ahead of the opponent's own draw.

name: Granite Thumbnotch
description: A sidelong step on a slope uses the gradient to add speed to the cut.

name: Thorn Birchhelve
description: The haft held in a sworn two-handed brace halts a heavy swing and drives it back.

name: Lambasting Pitch
description: A throw made as a gust unbalances the opponent lands with doubled surprise.

name: Tossassault
description: Step, throw and chop follow one bearing, so each strike lands before the opponent can reset.

name: Cleaving Chuck
description: Thrown axes scatter across an open ridge top and keep skirmishers apart.
